items.summary: Keep the site-factory pipeline limited to complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Do not admit implementation while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. The strongest candidate is complicated.work; its next step is one read-only launch-readiness artifact covering site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance, security, ownership, measurement, and rollback gates. Do not publish, deploy, add tracking, spend, or change domains.
